groups.title: Prometheus Architecture
groups.question: Explain how Prometheus collects and stores metrics, and how it finds what to scrape.

followUps.Data Model and Metric Types: Why does label cardinality matter so much for Prometheus, and what goes wrong when you pick the wrong metric type?
followUps.Scrape Configs and Service Discovery: What breaks with static scrape configs as a fleet grows, and how does service discovery fix it?

groups.title: Exporters and Instrumentation
groups.question: Walk through how metrics get exposed to Prometheus, both for standard software and for your own code.

followUps.Node Exporter and Infrastructure Exporte: Why would you reach for an existing exporter instead of writing your own scraper for a database or message broker?
followUps.Client Libraries for Custom Instrumentat: What kind of signal can you only get by instrumenting your own application, and what should you watch out for with labels when you do?

groups.title: PromQL Query Language
groups.question: Explain how you would query Prometheus data to build graphs and alerts that you can trust.

followUps.Aggregation and Functions: What is the difference between an instant vector and a range vector, and how does mixing them up lead to wrong graphs?
followUps.Recording Rules for Pre-computation: Why would you turn a query into a recording rule, and when does that become important?

groups.title: Alertmanager
groups.question: Explain how alerts get from Prometheus to the right people without overwhelming them.

followUps.Routing and Inhibition: How do routing and inhibition rules work together to stop an alert storm from hiding the root cause?
followUps.Silencing and On-Call Integration: Why is a silence a better tool than editing alert rules during a maintenance window?
